baseline.parser: sqlite3-parser@0.7.1 using the SQLite 3.53.0 grammar export

reasonCatalog.implemented: Implemented end to end in the current frontend, typed compiler, and profiled runtime.
reasonCatalog.canonical_lowering: The compiler replaces an underspecified or ambient SQLite behavior with a signed-context or canonical-order lowering.
reasonCatalog.frontend_lowering: The pinned SQLite parser accepts the syntax, but the current SQL-to-IR frontend has no complete lowering.
reasonCatalog.sql_first_protocol: The SQL-first transaction protocol, sequential prefix catalog, statement-result envelope, or DDL-capable candidate runner required by specification 10 is not implemented.
reasonCatalog.floating_profile: Canonical floating-point representation, rounding, formatting, aggregate ordering, and cross-platform conformance are not yet pinned.
reasonCatalog.json_profile: SQLite dynamic JSON/JSONB result typing, duplicate-key behavior, subtype propagation, and extension conformance are incomplete.
reasonCatalog.signed_time: The call can consult the host clock or timezone; it needs signed transaction-time injection and argument/modifier analysis.
reasonCatalog.deterministic_entropy: Raw SQLite randomness has optimizer-dependent invocation identity; it needs compiler-assigned stable call sites over the signed nonce.
reasonCatalog.candidate_state: The result depends on prior connection activity; the candidate connection needs specified initialization and ordered-body conformance.
reasonCatalog.aggregate_order: The result depends on aggregate input order; authored ordering and deterministic tie completion are not represented end to end.
reasonCatalog.peer_window: The value-window operation needs peer-preserving deterministic ordering without changing SQLite peer semantics.
reasonCatalog.canonical_representative: SQLite may choose any byte-distinct representative from values equal under a nonbinary collation; consensus needs a canonical representative without changing the authored equality relation.
reasonCatalog.semantic_resource: The syntax and logical semantics are implemented, but deterministic semantic work, row, recursion, or result budgets and stable exhaustion attribution are not enforced end to end.
reasonCatalog.registered_extension: The feature needs an immutable registered implementation/module digest, bounded-resource contract, rollback tests, and differential replay fixtures.
reasonCatalog.profile_identity: The value is safe only when exact SQLite/DoltLite build identity and returned bytes are committed by the execution profile.
reasonCatalog.external_effect: The feature reads or writes filesystem, network, process, logging, or dynamically loaded native state outside the atomic candidate.
reasonCatalog.transaction_control: Chronolog owns the candidate transaction/savepoint; nested transaction-control statements can escape or disrupt atomic reduction.
reasonCatalog.attached_or_temp: Attached databases and TEMP state are connection-local and are not part of the replicated Dolt application checkpoint.
reasonCatalog.pragma_state: The pragma mutates connection, planner, constraint, storage, or security state not scoped and restored by the candidate profile.
reasonCatalog.physical_storage: The value or effect reflects physical pages, WAL, cache, or allocator state rather than the replicated logical database.
reasonCatalog.maintenance_gate: Stored planner state, visitation order, rollback, and checkpoint effects need feature-specific replay conformance.
reasonCatalog.engine_option_absent: The optional SQLite grammar/runtime feature is not compiled into the pinned DoltLite build.
reasonCatalog.parser_version_skew: The mechanically generated frontend grammar version is older than the pinned SQLite runtime grammar, so newer syntax cannot be advertised until the parser and compatibility corpus are aligned.
reasonCatalog.protected_state: The feature can read or mutate protected Chronolog or Dolt control state.
reasonCatalog.protocol_invariant: This is a signed transaction-envelope invariant rather than a restriction on SQLite grammar or semantics.
reasonCatalog.sqlite_invalid: This is a defensive AST guard for syntax or arity SQLite itself does not define; it is not compatibility debt.
reasonCatalog.obsolete_ir: This public extension/schema IR belongs to the pre-SQL protocol and must be deleted or replaced by ordinary SQL/private compiler state, not expanded.

frontendRejectionInventory.marker: lowered program fails IR validation or compilation
duplicate or mutually circular CTE definition
invalid recursive CTE anchor, arm, reference, operator, aggregate, or window shape
recursive CTE without end-to-end semantic work and row budgets
NATURAL JOIN with ON or USING
qualified star through an explicit parenthesized join-group alias
star projection without a FROM source
FILTER on built-in non-aggregate window function
INSERT DEFAULT VALUES with a column list
UPSERT conflict target absent from the current UNIQUE catalog
row-value UPDATE assignment width or RHS shape
UPDATE FROM without a source relation
non-integral, negative, outside-safe-integer, or general-expression LIMIT/OFFSET
window placement, nesting, named inheritance, grouping-key, or impossible frame-shape violation
ROWS aggregate window with peer-sensitive EXCLUDE GROUP or EXCLUDE TIES
window expression in a mutation assignment, predicate, or conflict filter
nonbinary-collation DISTINCT, UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT, GROUP BY, MIN, or MAX representative
out-of-int64 or non-exact numeric literal/numeric exponent/decimal precision/hex wider than 64 bits
mixed positional/named, extra, floating, or non-canonical parameter binding
missing, out-of-range, or ambiguous parameter binding
SQLite 3.54-only syntax absent from the generated 3.53 frontend grammar
multiple statements in one envelope slot
table absent from the current catalog
